svg.title: The Experience Loop promise
svg.desc: You can delegate the code. Do not outsource your judgment with it. It strengthens your judgment, not the Agent's. Tasks still ship at full quality; at the moments that matter, evidence keeps the engineering judgment with you.

g.text: You can delegate the code. Do not outsource your judgment with it.
It strengthens your judgment, not the Agent's.
